stem: Which event from the excerpt from Kokoro best contributes to a theme connected to the importance of being authentic?

options.label: A
options.text: The narrator realizes that it is necessary for him to narrow his thesis topic.

options.label: B
options.text: Sensei admits that his academic learning is out of date.

options.label: C
options.text: Sensei explains why he has changed his attitude about books.

options.label: D
options.text: The narrator listens to the stories of friends who completed their theses on time.
